notes: Excluded under PROTOCOL §4 (duplicates) and the closed list (FT-DUPLICATE first). Primary record: P00158 (arXiv 2008.07119 v2, already coded, stratum speed). The pool record P00925 has no DOI or arXiv id; its title, authors (Jang, Kang) and date (2020-08-17) match arXiv 2008.07119 v1 exactly, confirmed on the arXiv abs page of v1 (2026-09-24). The v2 abs page shows the retitled version with Soyoung Yoo added, which is P00158. The study is the same: TopOpNet approximates the wheel TO algorithm of Oh et al.; GDNet (PPO) searches TO parameters for design diversity on the same crawled wheel images (639 references, 500/139 split; Sec. 3-4); the same timing statements appear. P00158 cites the Computer-Aided Design version of record as paywalled, so the latest arXiv version (v2, P00158) is the primary version, per the FT-DUPLICATE definition. Difference that matters for the verifier: v1's Table 1 compares models A and B only on image metrics (cross-entropy, pixel difference, IoU; no compliance), whereas v2's Table 1 adds a compliance error. A would-be R4 for v1 alone would therefore be fail (R4-image-metric), against partial as coded for P00158. The timing statements are the same in both versions. Screening flagged this record as a possible duplicate of P00158 (audit/pool/possible_duplicates.csv). COI check: no author named Jun Wang.
